Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A physician and a cashier each showed up early to drop their kids off at daycare today. It's easy to tell that the cashier has a close relationship with their kid based on how they hugged each other goodbye, but the physician just seemed to push the kid out the door, and the kid didn't seem surprised by this at all. Who is an inattentive parent?
A. The physician
B. Cannot answer
C. The cashier
